channel.title: West Hawaii Today - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from West Hawaii Today (westhawaiitoday.com)

item.title: If US attacks, Iran says it will strike US bases in the region
item.description: CAIRO (Reuters) — Iran will strike U.S. bases in the Middle East if it is attacked by U.S. forces that have massed in the region, its foreign minister said on Saturday, insisting that this should not be seen as an attack on the countries hosting them.

item.title: Sports leaders reach consensus on new gender policy, IOC says
item.description: MILAN — Global sports leaders have reached consensus on a new set of eligibility criteria for transgender athletes, with the new policy expected to be announced within the first half of this year, the International Olympic Committee said on Saturday.

item.title: US-led Board of Peace to hold first meeting of leaders February 19
item.description: The Board of Peace touted by U.S. President Donald Trump will hold its first leaders meeting on February 19, a U.S. government official confirmed on Saturday, without offering further details. The planned meeting was first reported by Axios, which said the gathering would also serve as a fundraising conference for the reconstruction of Gaza.

item.title: ICE protests, Bad Bunny flip script on Trump’s midterms playbook
item.description: Republicans are increasingly nervous that President Donald Trump’s slipping support on immigration and the economy — two key issues that helped him win in 2024 — could cost them the midterm elections. The Super Bowl halftime show won’t help their anxiety.

item.title: Ohio man is charged with threatening to kill JD Vance
item.description: An Ohio man was charged with threatening to shoot and kill Vice President JD Vance, federal prosecutors said Friday.

item.title: Whistleblower report involved intelligence about a Trump contact
item.description: WASHINGTON — Members of Congress were briefed this past week on a whistleblower report about an intelligence intercept of a call between two foreign nationals discussing a person close to President Donald Trump, according to people familiar with the material.

item.title: Hawaii legislative bills aim to rewrite crosswalk safeguards
item.description: Out on Kapahulu Avenue last week, pedestrian after pedestrian who waited at crosswalks to get to the other side welcomed a pair of bills moving through the state Legislature that would require drivers on all islands to wait even longer.

item.title: At a Seattle port rocked by tariffs, there were 70 jobs for 600 workers
item.description: SEATTLE — On many mornings, Sarah Esch’s job as a dispatcher for dockworkers at the Port of Seattle boils down to a question of simple, frustrating math.

item.title: HPD’s new chief discusses his approach to policing, priorities for the department
item.description: Policing is in the DNA of Hawaii County’s new top cop, Reed Mahuna.

item.title: UH gets grant for wildfire and land-use research
item.description: University of Hawaii researchers say new $2 million funding will help address one of the underlying drivers of wildfire risk across the islands: large areas of former plantation land now overrun with unmanaged, fire-prone invasive grasses.
